David Widger edited this linked index to the Project Gutenberg editions of Edward Bulwer-Lytton's works. Bulwer-Lytton, who lived from 1803 to 1873, wrote Athens: Its Rise and Fall, The Caxtons, Zicci, Eugene Aram, Pelham, Devereux, Ernest Maltrevers, and Kenelm Chillingly. His novels also include Harold, Lucretia, A Strange Story, The Last Days of Pompeii, and The Coming Race.

The index lists every volume and chapter, from My Novel and The Last of the Barons to Paul Clifford, Rienzi, Zanoni, and The Lady of Lyons. It lets a reader plan a path through a very large shelf, novel by novel. Bulwer-Lytton was once among England's most popular novelists, and this index helps modern readers find their way back to his romances, histories, and tales of the strange.
